description.value: G & R Ginseng Trading Ltd (養生堂 — 'Health Preservation Hall') is a Richmond-based specialty retailer focused on premium ginseng varieties, dried seafood (abalone, sea cucumber, fish maw, scallop), bird's nest, Korean red ginseng, and a broad range of Traditional Chinese Medicine products. The store offers both in-person and online shopping with delivery, serving Metro Vancouver's Chinese-Canadian community. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond's Capstan Way shopping area could find specialty health supplements and some dry-goods groceries, though the product range skews toward high-value culinary and medicinal items rather than everyday cycling supplies.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at grginseng.com is live and corroborates the OSM phone (604-276-9869), address (1433-8388 Capstan Way, Richmond BC V6X 4A7), and website URL. The store specialises in premium Chinese herbal medicines, dried seafood, ginseng, and bird's nest — a small 雜貨 (grocery) section exists but carries specialty items such as dried mushrooms, rice, and herbal teas rather than cycling-relevant staples. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist amenity appears anywhere on the site or in the OSM tags.
concerns: Store is a specialty TCM and premium health-food retailer; 'Groceries' category may mislead cyclists expecting a general food shop.
OSM address omits postal code; website footer adds V6X 4A7 — address updated to reflect this.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Neither required criterion (bike parking, water bottle refill) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags, and the store's product range — premium ginseng, dried seafood, TCM remedies — is not directly oriented toward touring cyclists; a site visit or direct contact would be needed to confirm whether basic cyclist amenities are available.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website is primarily in Traditional Chinese with an English language option; email sales@grginseng.com confirmed in site footer.
